assessor: RTS implementation preflight — Child A selective recall
rationale: The v1 implementation is bounded to a repository-local read-only semantic overlay above the existing Memory Index. It does not replace raw memory ownership, does not add a network/provider/vector store, does not mutate recalled sources, and cannot grant execution or promotion authority. Freshness, lifecycle eligibility, supersession, quarantine, event/scope matching, and smallest-anchor selection are deterministic and independently testable.
affected_boundaries: new selective_recall package with read-only routing and lifecycle validation
new memory sidecar registry containing metadata and source identities but no copied raw bodies
documentation of non-authority and rollback boundaries
existing_assumptions: rts_kernel/indexing/memory_index_engine.py remains the owner of the existing searchable Memory Index.
Raw historical source files remain authoritative for their own stored content and are not rewritten by recall routing.
Repository-local source bytes can be bound deterministically using Git blob identity without invoking Git, subprocess, network, or providers.
Historical evidence and lifecycle labels do not create current execution or promotion authority.
The existing Ultimate Loop boundaries HISTORICAL EVIDENCE != CURRENT AUTHORITY and RETRIEVAL != DECISION COMPETENCE remain controlling.
The operator's 2026-08-27 direction to implement these parts one by one authorizes Child A only after current BUILD_NOW and PASS gates are proven.

data_migration.notes: No existing memory/index/evidence records are rewritten. v1 adds a sidecar metadata registry and a read-only package.

external_interfaces: no deployment, publication, payment, messaging, or scheduling interface
approval_changes: Recall output permanently carries execution_authority=NONE and promotion_authority=NONE.
Lifecycle transition validation does not apply a transition and does not approve promotion.
Existing execution, Human Review, Skill Regression, and Promotion Application Preview authority boundaries remain unchanged.
Only RTS-FRZ-000011 may be selected/in-progress under WIP=1; children RTS-FRZ-000012 through RTS-FRZ-000015 remain FROZEN/NOT_APPROVED.
regression_tests: malformed duplicate and path-escape registry fail-closed behavior
insufficient signal does not guess relevance
execution and promotion authority always NONE
invalid lifecycle and direct RAW-to-CANONICAL transition rejection
allowed staged lifecycle transition validates without applying
existing memory index source and behavior unchanged
seed incident source bytes unchanged after routing
WIP contains only RTS-FRZ-000011 while active
hidden_dependencies: Git blob identity algorithm for local source freshness
Ultimate Loop historical-evidence/current-authority and retrieval/competence invariants
FREEZER Build Assessment / Preflight / WIP=1 runtime constraints
future promotion remains owned by existing learning/review/regression/preview packages
rollback_boundary: Revert only the selective_recall package, its sidecar registry, focused tests/docs, and RTS-FRZ-000011 implementation lifecycle revisions. Do not alter raw memory bodies, the existing Memory Index engine/index, Outcome Evidence, Skill promotion governance, or any adaptive-intelligence sibling child.
completion_conditions: A deterministic repository-local registry validates exact lifecycle vocabulary, provenance, source containment, and source freshness.
Current-context-sufficient requests take a deterministic no-recall fast path unless explicit recall is requested.
Relevant requests return only bounded metadata anchors and never inline/copy entire historical source bodies.
Stale, superseded, quarantined, malformed, and lifecycle-ineligible records cannot appear in default active recall.
Every output states execution_authority=NONE and promotion_authority=NONE.
Lifecycle transition validation rejects direct RAW-to-CANONICAL and never applies transitions automatically.
The existing Memory Index engine and seed incident bytes are unchanged by recall routing.
All focused selective-recall and existing FREEZER tests pass on the final Child A head.
FREEZER verification shows RTS-FRZ-000011 as the only IN_PROGRESS child during implementation and children B-E remain FROZEN/NOT_APPROVED.
Completion does not start or implement Child B, C, D, or E.
risks: Over-recall could add context instead of reducing recomputation.
A lifecycle state name such as CANONICAL could be misread as operational authority unless output boundaries are permanent and tested.
Source path/byte drift could make registry metadata stale.
Historical incident hypotheses could be treated too broadly if the anchor is read without its evidence scope.
Future callers could bypass the no-recall policy unless this package remains the bounded semantic owner.
